notes.title: Mac and Linux Version;Controller Support;Score Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Greetings Space Wars Community,

We are excited to announce we have updated Space Wars again. We have added a Mac and Linux Version, Controller Support, and fixed the Score Bug Glitch that would only allow high-scores of the top 4 regional scores to be posted to global leader-boards. Now all scores will be posted to global leader-boards as long as you are in top 1000 players and top 4 regional players will show up in regional section. Any questions, comments, or fixes email us at star.studios.1a@gmail.com. Cheers! 


Space Wars Team

notes.title: Level 3 Update; DLC (Level 4 Preview, Story, Ship Selection)
notes.notes:
We have just released level 3 Update. It includes new ships, backgrounds, music, and much more. Also we released a trailer for a level 4 which also has new ships, bosses, backgrounds, and music. In addition we are going to package a dlc which will include level 4 with a ton more story to the game and also an option to upgrade your ship by using score points. This dlc will be released in the next month or so. Stay updated by checking back peroidically. If 
you have any questions or comments email us at star.studios.1a@gmail.com. 

Happy gaming!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

notes.title: Level 2 Update
notes.notes: We just released level 2 for Space Wars!!!! It has major updates with new enemy ships, new bosses, and new strategies. As promised we will also be releasing level 3 in a few weeks time as well with huge updates!!!! Keep updated by checking back periodically. Enjoy!!!!!
